name: cad
description: Design, validate, render, inspect and publish parametric jewelry with Diatech Make through its hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Design rings, pendants, earrings and other jewelry as parametric 3D models. Start from a brief or a bundled example, refine dimensions and stone settings, and preview the design from multiple angles. Diatech Make validates DiaScript source, inspects geometry, reports dimensions, metal weight and stone placement, and publishes versioned designs with a shareable Review link.
defaultPrompt: Design a castable solitaire ring and show me previews.
Review my jewelry design for scale, wall thickness and stone placement.
Help me refine an existing Diatech Make design.
